name: Stackless BVH Ray Traversal for Occlusion
definition: Iterates over all entities in the scene to find the closest occlusion hit. It calls IntersectBVHStacklessOcclusion for each entity and returns the minimum positive intersection distance.
summary: Stackless BVH Ray Traversal for Occlusion performs global scene intersection by iterating through entities and traversing their BVHs to return the first valid hit, enabling efficient shadow casting and visibility checks.
